description: An agent that receives USD₮, converts it to IDRX (Indonesian rupiah stablecoin) on Textile FX, and pays the IDRX out to a named recipient — all on Celo mainnet, with ERC-8021 attribution on every transaction.
name: IDRX Payout Agent

services.description: USD₮ in, IDRX out to a named recipient via Textile FX (RFQ API v2) on Celo mainnet.
services.name: payout
